name: card/tilt-card
title: Tilt card
title_vi: Thẻ nghiêng với vầng sáng góc
desc_vi: Thẻ gradient nổi lên, rồi nghiêng nhẹ trong khi vầng sáng ở góc trôi theo hướng ngược lại.
params_vi: eyebrow: dòng nhỏ viết hoa phía trên · headline: tiêu đề lớn · glow: tight | standard | wide (vầng sáng rộng cỡ nào) · accent: indigo | emerald | violet (bộ màu thẻ) · scale: độ phóng to (2.5 như bản demo gốc, thẻ gốc 420 x 260 px)
notes: Layout, colours and motion as in the source (card 420 x 260 px, radius 30, 1 px rgba(255,255,255,.18) border, 135deg gradient #18181b -> accent, drop shadow 0 32 90 px in the accent colour at .34; corner glow radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%) with inset -18 / -30 / -46 % for tight / standard / wide; content padding 34 px, eyebrow 13 px weight 900 tracking .12em uppercase, headline 34 px line-height .96 max-width 280 px). The three accent palettes (indigo, emerald, violet: card colour, glow, label, shadow) are the source's. Motion: rise from opacity 0 and y 30 over 0.38 s power2.out; then rotateX 0 -> -7 and rotateY 0 -> 10 over 0.72 s power3.inOut, with the glow xPercent 0 -> 12 and yPercent 0 -> 10, starting 0.45 s after the rise (source: rise at 0.3 s, tilt at 0.75 s in its demo timeline). Like the source there is no perspective, so the tilt is an orthographic squeeze (the card has overflow hidden, which flattens preserve-3d anyway); translateZ(38px) on the content is kept as written. Differences: the source demo wrapped the card in a scale(2.5) frame; here that is the param `scale` (default 2.5) and every px size (including the y 30 offset) is multiplied by it; the card is centred in the target box; the source's script reading variables becomes params. Default texts are Vietnamese (source: English).
